basis: Hand-written models and complete expected path/edge/arc/delay/arrival/required/slack facts, frozen before production. Self-authored, not third-party adoption. Ns constants converted to seconds only; no graph/path algorithm in oracle.

sdc.base:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports out]
sdc.unknown_launch:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports out]
sdc.unknown_required:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
sdc.large_latency:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports out]
set_clock_latency 1e18 [get_clocks c]
sdc.cancellation:
create_clock -name c -period 1e20 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 1e20 [get_ports out]
sdc.range:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 2 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports out]
sdc.gba:
create_clock -name c -period 4 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports out]
set_load 2 [get_ports out]
sdc.sequential:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_clock_latency 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports a]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports {y z}]
sdc.multioutput:
create_clock -name c -period 3 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports out]
sdc.identity:
create_clock -name c -period 2 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c 0.1 [get_ports {b/~😀}]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.2 [get_ports {out/~😀}]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.5 [get_ports {u/Y}]
set_output_delay -clock c 0.7 [get_ports {u~1Y}]
sdc.overflow:
create_clock -name c -period 1e308 [get_ports clk]
set_clock_transition 0.1 [get_clocks c]
set_input_transition 0.1 [get_ports *]
set_input_delay -clock c 1e308 [get_ports a]
set_input_delay -clock c -1e308 [get_ports b]
set_output_delay -clock c 0 [get_ports out]
